text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You heard a violin from the main hall,
you say?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It must have been me. I was using a room
there at
that time. I hope the noise was
not too much of a
distraction.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...It wasn't? Well, I will still be careful
next time.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am yet amateurish at best, you see.
